title: StrokeCore glyph pack
description: An ordered set of traceable glyphs. Geometry only: no spoken text, no translations, no curriculum. Spoken names, phonics and example words live in translations so a pack is not multiplied by language.

packId.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case. Referenced by attempt records, so it must not change once shipped.

packSchemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the pack targets. StrokeCore refuses a pack whose schema version it does not know. Version 2 adds cursive join anchors.

packVersion.description: Content revision, bumped on any geometry change. Recorded in attempt records so a replay against a re-authored glyph is identifiable.

style.description: Which handwriting convention this pack follows. 'shape' and 'number' packs are not handwriting styles but share the format.

viewBox.description: [minX, minY, width, height]. All stroke coordinates and guide values are in this space; the client scales it to the screen. Every glyph in a pack shares one viewBox so glyphs are mutually consistent in size.

guides.description: Horizontal writing guides in viewBox y-coordinates, drawn behind the glyph. Omit for shape packs, which have no baseline.

groups.description: Presentation grouping for the glyph grid. A glyph's groupId must appear here.

id.description: Stable within the pack. Recorded in attempt records, so it must not change once shipped.

char.description: The character or short label this glyph represents. Used as the tile face and as the translation lookup key. Not spoken directly — the spoken form comes from translations.

strokes.description: Ordered. Index 0 is drawn first. Order is pedagogical content, not an implementation detail.

strokeOrderStrict.description: Whether strokes must be traced in the listed order. Defaults to true; set false for glyphs where order genuinely does not matter.

joins.description: Reserved for packSchemaVersion 2 (cursive entry/exit anchors). Must be null in version 1.

d.description: SVG path data. The direction of travel is the direction of the path — reversing the path reverses what the child is taught. Supported commands: M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute and relative. A path must contain exactly one subpath: one stroke is one continuous pen-down movement.

keyPoints.description: Hand-placed key points as normalized arc-length positions in [0,1], ascending. Omit to let StrokeCore generate them from curvature and spacing. 0 and 1 are implicit and need not be listed.

widthScale.description: Multiplies the tolerance corridor width for this stroke. Use above 1 for a stroke that is legitimately harder to be precise about, such as a long diagonal.
